post.text:
Many of us have had to reach for our coats and umbrellas over the last few days as bands of rain with heavy falls have crossed the country. 🧥☔

Some stations in the Tasman District recorded a whopping 400-700 mm of rain in 48 hours! 🌧️

🔎Rainfall Radar: metservice.com/maps-radar

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
